2.15.15
Subreport.Visibility
The Subreport.Visibility element specifies whether a Subreport is hidden or toggled by a Textbox.
This element is optional. This element is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0"/>
